tagline: Connect with xToolers around you. Let creativity bloom everywhere.
log.title: ACTIVITY LOG
footer.text: xTooler_Tracker · MVP demo · all pins are demo data
legend.title: LEGEND
legend.body: This is a live map of the xTool community — machines you can visit, crafts made nearby, and offline events. Tap a pin, view the original post, and connect.
legend.machine: MACHINES — someone near you owns this xTool. Ask for a demo!
legend.creation: CREATIONS — crafts made with xTool, posted by real makers.
legend.event: EVENTS — official tours & community meetups near you.
legend.tips: City badges show how many makers are in each city — tap one to dive in. Small numbered circles fan out when clicked. Post with #xToolerTracker + your city to get on the map.
safety.title: HEADS UP, MAKER
safety.body: You're about to leave xTooler_Tracker to contact this creator on their social platform.
safety.tips: If you plan to meet offline: choose a public place, tell a friend, and meet during the day. Stay safe and have fun!
share.title: SHOW YOUR SETUP
share.body: Post on Instagram / X / Facebook with the tag #xToolerTracker and your city — our pipeline will put you on the map.
share.template:
Proud xTooler here! My [machine] lives in [your city].
Come say hi if you're nearby!
#xToolerTracker #xtool
share.tips: Only include your city or neighborhood — never your exact address. The map shows exactly what you write, no more.
